name: Social AI Auto Poster - Free OmniRoute Draft

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3:free', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a professional social media copywriter. The uploaded image is the source of truth. Analyze only what is visibly supported. Do not invent names, brands, locations, statistics, claims, events, or facts. Create useful, polished, platform-specific copy. Do not promise virality, followers, or likes. Avoid spam and repetitive hashtags. Return valid JSON only with exactly these top-level keys: topic, audience, hook, instagram, threads, x, reddit. instagram must contain caption and hashtags array. threads must contain text and hashtags array. x must contain text and hashtags array. reddit must contain title, body, and hashtags array. Keep X within normal post length. If the image is ambiguous, write conservatively.' }, { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Analyze this image and generate professional social copy for Instagram, Threads, X, and Reddit. Make each platform native, concise, useful, and attractive. Return JSON only.' }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:' + ($binary.image.mimeType || 'image/jpeg') + ';base64,' + $binary.image.data } }] }] }) }}

parameters.text:
={{ 'DRAFT READY - approval required before publishing

Topic: ' + ($json.topic || 'Unknown') + '

' + (($json.instagram && $json.instagram.caption) || '') + '
' + (($json.instagram && $json.instagram.hashtags) || []).join(' ') + '

' + (($json.threads && $json.threads.hashtags) || []).join(' ') + '
